customManagers.description: uv pin inside GitHub Actions workflows. Dependabot cannot do this — its github-actions manager only bumps `uses:` SHAs, and there is no manager for .prototools. Both spellings CI uses are matched: the workflow `env:` key and ci.yml's shell assignment.

uv pinned in the core Dockerfile — it builds the SHIPPED image, so it resolves the production dependency set. The dockerfile manager alone would treat it as a generic image bump; this makes it join the grouped uv PR so it can never drift from .prototools.

packageRules.description: CRITICAL: .prototools, every workflow UV_VERSION, and the core Dockerfile's uv must move in ONE PR. tests/unit/test_workflow_invariants.py asserts they match exactly (#525), so a bot bumping only one location reds the build. NOTE: ci.yml also carries UV_SHA256 for the WSL tarball, which Renovate CANNOT compute — a version bump requires updating it from https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/<version>/<tarball>.sha256 or the WSL leg fails its checksum verification (by design, fail-closed).
